title: Three baskets
concept: Every euro you spend falls into one of three baskets. Each basket needs a different kind of attention.

title: Your balance is not your budget
concept: Part of the money on your account already belongs to rent, bills and surprises. What's left is safe to spend.

title: Surprises are predictable in bulk
concept: You can't know which month the surprise comes. You can know roughly how much a year of them costs.

title: The money that slips through your fingers
concept: Small purchases don't register one by one. Counted together they are a real line in your year.

title: Think in pay cycles, not calendar months
concept: Your money doesn't reset on the 1st. It resets on payday, and the tight days are the ones just before it.

title: A buffer buys time
concept: A buffer isn't measured in euros. It's measured in months you could keep paying your musts.

title: Pay yourself first
concept: Money moved aside on payday gets saved. Money you plan to save 'if something is left' rarely is.

title: Small percentage, big year
concept: You don't have to give anything up. Trimming one habit by a fifth is hard to feel and easy to see after a year.
